system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: At each step, the system combines global memory with the current task specification to form an execution context.
system_prompt_style.note: Always-on L1 memory index plus continuously injected working-memory anchor; code not in evidence bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: file_read supports segmented reads (start/count), keyword anchoring, and line-number output, so GA can inspect only the relevant regions.
env_context_strategy.note: Always-on memory index injected but that is memory, not environment context.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Tool outputs are first truncated with a head-tail policy to bound the size of individual messages. Redundant content in older messages is then compressed at the tag level to remove low-value fragments. When the global context budget is exceeded, the oldest messages are evicted in chronological order.
context_compaction.note: Tag-level compression mapped to summarize (heuristic); quote exceeds 40 words slightly—core evidence is head-tail truncation and oldest eviction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Its browser interaction layer represents web pages through semantically structured observations rather than raw HTML
observation_format.note: web_scan serializes simplified DOM; closest value a11y_tree. Screenshots via vision are opt-in self-built capability.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: | `native` + `claude` | NativeClaudeSession | API 原生 tool 字段 | **推荐首选** — Claude 原生协议 |
tool_call_format.note: Deprecated ClaudeSession/LLMSession use text-protocol tools (文本协议工具); exact syntax not shown, xml_tags closest guess.

tool_count.evidence_quote: GenericAgent provides only **9 atomic tools**, forming the foundational capabilities for interacting with the outside world.
tool_count.note: Count from README tool table; tool schema code not in bundle.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: file_patch enforces unique old_content matching and fails fast on zero or multiple matches

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each tool defines a name, a description, and a set of parameters described by JSON Schema, all under a consistent type function format.

protocol_standardization.note: No source tree or dependency file in bundle to grep for mcp/a2a.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The LLM processes this context and produces either direct outputs or tool calls. Tool execution is delegated to external modules, and the results are returned as structured signals that update the system state.
loop_primitives.note: Reflect/Goal modes (trigger-driven, time-budget loops) exist in reflect/ but code not in bundle.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Working memoryis continuously injected across turns, carrying only the minimal necessary task state: current objectives, constraints, and progress.
planning_granularity.note: update_working_checkpoint stores objectives/progress re-injected each turn; Plan mode also mentioned in docs.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: GA is organized around a unified agent loop that connects the model with the environment.
multi_agent_topology.note: Conductor sub-agent orchestration and Goal Hive master/workers are reachable modes (README roadmap).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Conductor sub-agent orchestration**. Spawn, supervise, and auto-clean parallel sub-agents
delegation_mechanism.note: Default none; opt-in subagent_spawn via Conductor/subagent mode.

human_in_loop.note: Model-invoked ask_user tool; closest value on_permission.

short_term_state.note: Could be scratchpad; paper describes objectives/constraints/progress fields.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: | **L4** | Session Archive | Archived task records distilled from finished sessions for long-horizon recall |
long_term_memory.note: L2 facts (file_notes), L3 SOPs/skills (skill_library), L4 session archive (episodic_db).

state_persistence.note: /continue picker suggests session continuation; code not shown.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: code_run is restricted to one invocation per turn, ensuring each result is observed before the next action is planned.
retry_policy.note: Mixin max_retries is LLM transport failover, not task retry.

termination_condition.note: Paper mentions explicit execution bounds without detail; loop code missing.

cost_controls.note: Config schema partially shown only; <30K context target is design goal.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: it grants any LLM system-level control over a local computer

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: it grants any LLM system-level control over a local computer

network_policy.note: No network config surface in bundle.

target_domain.evidence_quote: covering browser, terminal, filesystem, keyboard/mouse input, screen vision, and mobile devices (ADB)

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The system is model-agnostic: the underlying reasoning engine (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini) can be replaced without affecting execution logic
model_agnostic.note: Own OAI-compatible and Claude-native sessions, not litellm.

first_release_date.note: Basis: README release note; first tag date not in evidence.

stars.note: Date of star count not stated in evidence.
